newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN KINDLUSTUSE GRUPP PLANS 12 STORY BUILDING-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN KINDLUSTUSE GRUPP PLANS 12 STORY BUILDING-REPORT.

text.p: AB Kindlustuse grupp is planning to start construction of a 12 story office block in Tallinn in August, Aripaev business paper said on Monday.
The project is expected to provide 10,500 square meters of office space at a cost of 120-130 million kroons, the daily added.
"Three of the largest banks in Estonia are interested in financing the project," Leonid Apananski, chairman of the group, was quoted as saying in the newspaper.
The new building will be located in downtown Tallinn close to the Stockmann department store.
AB Kinlustuste grupp includes the ASA insurance company and AB Life Insurance.
